THE ARMED FORCES (EMERGENCY DUTIES) ACT, 1947.
1ACT No. XV OF 1947
[20th March, 1947]
An Act to enable duties in connection with vital services to be imposed in an emergency on the
Armed Forces of 2[Pakistan].

WHEREAS it is expedient to enable duties in connection with vital services to be imposed in an
emergency on the Armed Forces of 2[Pakistan]; It is hereby enacted as follows:__
1. Short title and extent.__ (1) This Act may be called the Armed Forces (Emer gency Duties)
Act, 1947.
3[(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.]
2. Emergency duties of Armed Forces.__ (1) The 4[Federal Government] may, by notification5
in the official Gazette, declare any specified service to be a service of vital importance to the
community:
Provided that such notification shall remain in force for one month in the first instance, but may
be extended, from time to time, by a like notification.
(2) Upon a declaration being made under sub‑section (1) and until it is rescinded, it shall be the
duty of every person subject to 6* * * the Pakistan Army Act, 1952],6* * * 7[or the
Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953], or the 8[Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961], to obey any command given
by any superior officer in relation to employment upon or in connection with the service specified in
the declaration; and every such command shall be deemed to be a lawful command within the
meaning and for the purposes of the said Acts 9[or Ordinance].
3. [Validation of certain past Commands.] Rep. by the Federal Laws (Revision and Declaration)
Act, 1951 (XXVI of 1951), s. 3 and Second Schedule.
1For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1947, Pt.V, p.128.
The Act has been applied to Baluchistan, see Gazette of India, 1947, Pt.I, p.535.
The Act has been extended to the Leased Areas of Baluchistan by the Leased Areas (Laws) Order, 1950 (G.G.O.3 of 1950).
